## New in this release

### Fixed
- **Reporting absences:** the app now sends the school's real security token (CSRF) and the same headers as the browser. Before, it sent the token's name instead of its value, so the server refused the report. Still being tested.

### Known issues
- **Reporting absences** (parent accounts) may still not work.

### Alpha
- Test build with the Debug screen (menu → Debug). In the "web session: … values found" entry, "csrfAt" should now read "data.csrfToken". It installs over 0.4.6-alpha.2 and is replaced by the next beta.
